# The cases for PlainVersion, one "<version> <true|false>" per line. Blank lines and lines starting with "#"
# are skipped. buildinfo's TestPlainVersion and render's copy of the rule both run this table.

# Plain versions
0.1.0 true
26.11.0 true
0.0.0 true
2.11.9 true
10.20.30 true
1.0.10 true

# A leading v
v26.11.0 false
v0.1.0 false
V1.0.0 false

# A leading zero
26.011.0 false
01.0.0 false
1.00.0 false
1.0.01 false

# Two or four parts
26.11 false
1 false
26.11.0.1 false
1.0.0.0 false

# A pre-release
26.11.0-rc1 false
0.2.0-dev.3 false
1.0.0-alpha false

# A build part
26.11.0+b1 false
1.0.0+20260101 false
1.0.0-rc.1+b1 false

# Empty parts and other characters
1..0 false
.1.0 false
1.0. false
1.0.a false
1.-1.0 false
latest false
